			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = cfa_franc } NOT = { has_idea = cfa_franc_2 } } add_ideas = cfa_franc }
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_operations_account
			add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_FRA_french_credit_line days = 365 }
			add_to_array = { global.COLDWAR_FRA_franc_zone = THIS }
			FRA = {
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_delta = 3 }
				COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_change = yes
				COLDWAR_FRA_franc_zone_refresh = yes
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_FRA.101 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 1
		}
	}

	COLDWAR_FRA_leave_franc_zone = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_break_treaty
		allowed = { always = yes }
		visible = {
			has_idea = COLDWAR_FRA_operations_account
		}
		available = {
			has_political_power > 149
		}
		cost = 150
		fire_only_once = no
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_FRA_leave_franc_zone"
			if = { limit = { has_idea = cfa_franc } remove_ideas = cfa_franc }
			if = { limit = { has_idea = cfa_franc_2 } remove_ideas = cfa_franc_2 }
			remove_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_operations_account
			add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_FRA_capital_flight days = 365 }
			add_stability = -0.10
			remove_from_array = { global.COLDWAR_FRA_franc_zone = THIS }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = FRA } FRA = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_delta = -5 } COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_change = yes COLDWAR_FRA_franc_zone_refresh = yes country_event = { id = COLDWAR_FRA.111 days = 1 } } }
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 0
		}
	}
